title: Ammonia smell and staining inside the Red Pyramid

tellings.quote: There's chemical staining all over the walls and an intense smell of ammonia that emanates from the final chamber.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2017 he went inside the Red Pyramid, an ancient pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt. He says the walls are covered in chemical staining and a strong smell of ammonia comes from the final chamber. He offers this as a clue that the pyramids may once have had a chemical purpose, not just a burial one.
